t.Marghar, o Criador dos Caminhos.<br>Ahzu:
Marghar, Maker of Paths.
Ahzur, the Hunger.
And the Labyrinth of the walkers.
Before there were roads, there was the Before. It was neither dark nor light, because there was no one to see the difference.
t.Foi dentro do Antes que <b>Marghar, o Se: It was inside the Before that Marghar, Lord of Paths, thought of walking, and that was enough. But something was trapped in the Before that had never been anything but will. When Marghar thought of walking, it broke loose too: Ahzur, the Stepless, the Hunger. It got a straight, fast road, and at its end were those who did not yet know how to walk.
t.Marghar não julgou, não lutou, não prend: Marghar did not judge, did not fight, did not imprison. He made paths, plural. Where there was a straight line, he made forks; where there was a door, he made a thousand doors. All of Karmika is that Labyrinth, and every choice is one more wall between the Hunger and the souls.
What was planted will be returned.
t.Do desejo de esconder as almas, e do des: From the wish to hide the souls, and from the opposite wish to offer oneself to the Hunger, karma was born. While you live, it is liquid and still changes. When the Thread of Life breaks, the soul rises to the Threshold, and chooses how to return.

t.Cada ato tem peso, e o peso depende do m: Every deed has weight, and the weight depends on the motive. Sparing a boss who offers gold is selling your own nobility. Sparing someone who truly repents is faith in the other. Marghar's Karmic Eye follows everything, shows in a window the why of each judgment and keeps the result in your soul.
t.Enquanto você vive, o karma é <b>líquido: While you live, karma is liquid: it still grows, changes, can be diverted. It opens and closes doors: guards who distrust you, priests who refuse the blessing, whole villages that celebrate when you arrive. Killing an NPC costs the peace they would have lived; killing a player costs double, because the soul comes back and remembers.

t.Quando o <b>Fio da Vida</b> se rompe, a: When the Thread of Life breaks, the soul rises to the Threshold, at the center of the cosmic labyrinth. There, Orvalen, the Reader of Tracks, reads your life, and Sael, She Who Returned, guides the way back. You choose: return to the same body with a Karmic Debt, be reborn in another people, or pay the return with a Tear of the Eye.
t.O personagem acaba. A alma e a sua histó: The character ends. The soul and its story go on. Someone who was a vampire and fell into a hunter's hands may come back thirsty and disgusted by garlic; mystics sense the old soul, and some come after it.
t.O Fio da Vida se rompe: as três voltas: The Thread of Life breaks: the three returns
t.Em KARMIKA você não perde o personagem p: In KARMIKA you do not lose your character to death: you lose the body. The soul rises to the Threshold with everything it did (karma, marks, past lives) and decides how to return.
t.<b>O mesmo corpo</b>, carregando uma Dív: The same body, carrying a Karmic Debt in experience.
t.<b>Renascer</b> em outro povo, numa vila: Rebirth in another people, in a village you do not know, with echoes of the previous life.
t.<b>A Lágrima</b>: pagar a volta exata, n: The Tear: pay for the exact return, at the nearest sacred place.
t.Os grandes de cada ordem não chegaram lá: The great ones of each order did not get there in a single life: the echo of the past life speeds up whoever returns to the same path, and each incarnation brings you closer to the top of your order.
Everyone starts as a human, dwarf or elf. At level 30, the Seer of Paths asks questions, looks at your soul and reveals where it leans, but the choice is yours. Every path begins with a real journey to the master: Thorgrim at the Fortress of Odin, Grand Master Cassius at the Abbey of the Dawn, Count Vladislav in the castle on the Hill, Ulfrun in the Lycanthrope Jungle…
t.Vampiro e lobisomem não se matriculam: a: Vampires and werewolves do not enroll: the road leads to the bite or to the tribe's ritual. And those who would rather wait follow the Human Path: building, planting, bringing people together and founding a guild.

t.Cada golpe tem peso. O inimigo prepara o: Every blow has weight. The enemy winds up the attack and you read the move: dodge, parry with the blade, raise the shield at the right moment and break the elites' guard. Skeletons feel the impact, demons fear the holy, werewolves only truly fall before the light.
t.Masmorras com nome, dono e motivo para e: Dungeons with a name, an owner and a reason to exist; bosses that grow with you; elites that surrender and beg. Outside the villages, the banners clash freely, but wounding your own side is treason, and killing has a price in karma.

The house takes days of work, and with the Brass Company contract, Work Helpers work for you, even with the game closed (protected by a Sentinel).

t.No Vale da Desgraça, Malgrath, Senhor do: In the Vale of Ruin, Malgrath, Lord of Pacts, does not teach: he bargains. Every power of the warlock is borrowed, and every loan has interest, paid in blood, in soul or in favors.

t.A Cobrança arranca menos: 22/19/16/12% d: The Collection takes less: 22/19/16/12% of health instead of 25%. The stun drops to 0.8/0.6/0.4/0 s. At level 4, the Collection lets out a scream of Malgrath that terrifies enemies within 6 m for 1 s.
